error_pattern:
System.Text.Json.JsonReaderException : 'M' is invalid after a single JSON value. Expected end of data. LineNumber: 164 | BytePositionInLine: 0.
   at System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(ReadOnlyMemory`1 json, JsonDocumentOptions options)
   at Infrastructure.Tests.Hex1bNativePublishingTests.NativeAssetsKeepTheirLayoutAndContents(String rid, Boolean singleFile) in /_/tests/Infrastructure.Tests/Hex1bNativePublishingTests.cs:line 38
analysis: The test invokes MSBuild and captures its JSON item output for validation. The JsonReaderException indicates the captured output stream was truncated or had extraneous content appended mid-parse ('M' after valid JSON), which is characteristic of a race/buffering issue in how the JSON is produced/captured rather than a logic bug in the test or PR code. The PR under test only changes Azure provisioning proxy generation code and does not touch Hex1b native publishing or MSBuild JSON emission, and this exact failure signature was previously observed with a different rid (win-x64).
